h1: Thai Guest House Bung Khong Long — a Thai-style house in a garden, budget rates with free breakfast
intro: If you're visiting Bueng Khong Long, Naka Cave or Phu Langka on a tight budget and want a clean, low-cost stay where the owner looks after you, Thai Guest House is a name guests speak of warmly · It's a 2-star guest house of Thai-style rooms in a garden, around 10 rooms, set near Bueng Khong Long market and public park · Rooms are clean with air-con, a fridge and a TV, and breakfast is free · From approx ฿600/night, including breakfast for two.

body.html: Thai Guest House sits in Moo 12, Bueng Khong Long sub-district, Bueng Khong Long, Bueng Kan, within the community and walking distance of Bueng Khong Long market and public park · It isn't a large hotel but a small Thai-style guest house of around 10 rooms set in a garden · What guests mention from the first step is the owner's warmth and a level of cleanliness above the price — a good fit for travellers driving or busing in to see the area's natural sights who want somewhere cheap but not cramped.

The rooms split across two houses · Thai House 1 is the original block, with rates starting in the low hundreds of baht and including breakfast for two, while Thai House 2 is the newer building at a slightly higher rate · Every room has air-con, a fridge, a flat-screen TV, a hairdryer and an en-suite bathroom · Guests regularly praise how clean the rooms are, comfortable beds and the basics being covered for this price · The gripes some note are that, being a budget guest house, the decor and amenities are simple rather than hotel-plush, and rooms in the original block are compact.
"Great service, the owner is so friendly, a budget stay yet clean, with free breakfast, and near the market so it's easy to walk out for food — better value than the price suggests."

Service and breakfast are what push Thai Guest House's score up · Breakfast is a local-style morning meal included for two in the room rate · Many reviews agree the owner hosts you like family, happy to advise on the route to Naka Cave, Phu Langka and the sights around Bueng Khong Long · The guest house has a garden, a restaurant, free bicycles to borrow and free parking · Being near the market means you can walk out for an evening meal rather than driving far as you would from a stay outside the community.

What you have to accept is that it isn't right by Naka Cave or Bueng Khong Long lake within walking distance · From here it's still around a 7–8 km drive to the Naka Cave trailhead and the lake · That makes it better suited to people with a car or a chartered ride arranged than to those without · A few reviews also note that, being in the community near the market, there can be some surrounding noise at times — which is about the central location rather than the guest house itself.

To be straight about it, Thai Guest House suits budget travellers visiting Naka Cave and Bueng Khong Long who want a clean stay, low-hundreds rates and a caring owner · A score of around 8.7 from real reviews, with consistent praise for the service and breakfast, suggests most guests leave impressed by the value · The trade-offs to weigh are simple rooms for the price, a location that needs a drive on to Naka Cave, and some community noise at times.

A tip from reading the reviews: ask for Thai House 2 if you want a newer room, or choose Thai House 1 for the lowest rate · Rooms are limited, and they fill fast on long weekends and during the Naka Cave season, so book ahead · And chat with the owner about chartering a ride or the route up to Naka Cave at check-in — it makes planning the next day much easier.

honestSummary: Thai Guest House sells cleanliness, low-hundreds rates and warm, hands-on hosting in Bueng Khong Long — a strong fit for budget travellers visiting Naka Cave and the lake · The free breakfast and a location near the market win plenty of praise · Just accept the rooms are simple for the price, it isn't within walking distance of Naka Cave, and the central setting can carry some noise at times.
honestChecks: If you want plush rooms or full hotel amenities — this is a budget guest house with simple rooms and decor → if you're after polish, try a hotel in Bueng Kan town or a garden resort instead.
If you don't have your own car — you can walk to the market, but Naka Cave and the lake are still around a 7–8 km drive → arrange a chartered ride or ask the owner about transport in advance.

If you sleep lightly and are serious about quiet — being in the community near the market, there can be surrounding noise at times → ask for an inner room or Thai House 2, and pack earplugs just in case.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Thai Guest House Bung Khong Long, Bueng Kan

faq.q: Where is Thai Guest House, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Thai Guest House is at 195/2 Moo 12, Bueng Khong Long sub-district, Bueng Khong Long, Bueng Kan · It's within the community, walking distance to the market and near Bueng Khong Long public park · It's about a 7-minute drive to Kham Somboon Beach on the lake and around 20 minutes to the Naka Cave trailhead · It makes a good base for Naka Cave and Phu Langka.

faq.q: How much does Thai Guest House cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿600/night including breakfast for two for an A/C room in Thai House 1 (the original block) · Thai House 2 is the newer building at around ฿1,000 · Every room has air-con, a fridge, a TV and an en-suite bathroom · Prices vary by season — always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is Thai Guest House best for?
faq.a: It suits budget travellers visiting Naka Cave and Bueng Khong Long who want a clean stay at low-hundreds rates · The Thai-style garden setting, hands-on owner and a location near the market for easy meals all help · If you want plush rooms or full hotel amenities, it may not be the right fit.

faq.q: What is breakfast like at Thai Guest House?
faq.a: Breakfast is a local-style morning meal included for two in the room rate · It's a praised part of the stay in reviews, both the food and the owner's care · Check at booking whether your chosen rate includes breakfast, as some rates may differ.

faq.q: What should I know before booking Thai Guest House?
faq.a: The guest house has only around 10 rooms and fills fast on long weekends and during the Naka Cave season, so book ahead · Rooms and decor are simple for the price · It isn't by Naka Cave or the lake — it's a 7–8 km drive on, so arrange a ride if you have no car · And being in the community near the market, there can be some surrounding noise at times — if you sleep lightly, pack earplugs.
